ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity patches located at the distal lateral margins of both lobes. Central and proximal regions are characterized by a solid low-intensity mask with sparse high-intensity linear and circular insertions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 65-70 degrees and a depth of approx 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edges exhibit high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; the distal left lobe exhibits a deep, low-frequency indentation (notch) approximately 30 pixels wide.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature terminating in sharp, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) visible in the mid-left lobe and along the far-right trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-60 pixels) oriented perpendicularly to the trailing edge, primarily visible in the dark central lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical linear scarring (rake marks) on both lobes; irregular jagged traumatic loss of tissue on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe distal tip.
